variants.title: Limits of a multimeter at high frequency: AC current
variants.sample: AC current range of a digital multimeter
variants.unknown: the frequency at which the AC current reading is 3 dB low
variants.note: The current ranges of a multimeter run through a shunt and are usually less wideband than the voltage ranges. The 5 kHz figure is illustrative: the meter's own manual gives the real one.

source.title: AC current bandwidth of 5 kHz is illustrative; every meter's manual states its own
